reviews.title: Unmatched for the price point and solid speeds
reviews.comment: Very solid ram for the price, especailly when it comes to value for the money it is there, the RGB lights up nicely, and solid build quailty, remember to enable the XMP profile in the bios and get the full speed, the price was awesome on sale. solid fit and easy to intall, looks good in the case as well, you won't be dissapointed by the product. memory speed for me is 3600 and performing very well, stable and no issues, check your MoBo for specs and speeds it can handle. speed fast and strong, stable at clock speeds great product for this in need.

reviews.title: They work well but there can be issues
reviews.comment: I bought these for my setup originally in 2021. I bought these again so I could have 64gb of ram. I have 4 sticks of ram on my msi b550 tomahawk motherboard. I like the ram’s style and rgb but there’s one issue I haven’t been able to solve. In windows task manager it shows that I have 64gb of ram but when I go into the bios it shows the two new sticks as unknown and the 2 original sticks as patriot. This is extremely confusing for me. Idk if this is how it’s supposed to be or I did something wrong. The ram is installed properly and seated perfectly. I can’t find anything on any website or YouTube video that explains how to fix this. Maybe someone here can but other than that I’ve had 0 issues with this ram. It’s reliable, fast and looks good in any setup
